Full-Service Pest Control

One licensed crew for the whole problem — identifying the pest, treating the infestation, and sealing up what let it in. No handoffs between three separate companies.

Roach Clean Outs

For heavy roach infestations in a house or apartment, we run the action machine through the unit to flush out the entire German roach population — not just the ones on the counter.

Learn more →

Beehive Removal

Live hive removal from walls, eaves, and structures — including large 50 lb. hives inside apartment buildings. Non-chemical treatment, handled in full protective gear.

Learn more →

Bird Proofing

Sealing the openings under roof eaves and ledges so birds can't nest there again. Stops the droppings, the mites, and the repeat cleanup every spring.

Learn more →

Rodent Trapping

Multiple traps set under the crawl space and through the sub-area to clear out an active rodent infestation under the house, then checked and reset until it's quiet.

Learn more →

Rodent Control

Tamper-resistant rodent boxes placed around the exterior perimeter for ongoing control. Pet safe and child proof, serviced on a schedule so the pressure stays off the building.

Learn more →

Bed Bug Treatment

Our specialty. Vacuum treatment to physically lift every live bed bug and egg off the mattress, frame, and seams, followed by targeted treatment so they don't reestablish.

01

Common questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does pest treatment cost?

It depends on the pest, the size of the property, and how far the infestation has spread. We inspect first, give you a written price before anything starts, and you decide from there.

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. The initial consultation and estimate are free.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes — licensed and insured in California under #1103089.

How do you treat bed bugs?

We vacuum first to physically lift the live bed bugs and eggs off the mattress, box spring, frame, and seams, then treat the harborage areas. Vacuuming alone misses eggs; spraying alone leaves the population you can't reach. Both together is what actually clears a unit.

Are treatments safe for kids and pets?

We use licensed, label-approved products and tell you exactly what's applied, where, and how long to stay out of the treated area. Exterior rodent boxes are tamper-resistant, pet safe, and child proof.

What areas do you serve?

Santa Clarita and the surrounding valley — Canyon Country, Valencia, Saugus, Newhall, and Stevenson Ranch — plus commercial and residential work across greater Los Angeles.
